_comment: Items audit-quest-granted flagged that were REVIEWED and REJECTED — the
quest does not hand them over, so they stay ordinary requirements. There
is no annotation flag for 'reviewed, not granted' (a rejection means the
item is just normal), so without this file every settled question
re-reports on every run and the audit never converges.
Key is '<stepId> <item name>', matching the audit's own handled-set key.
Cite the evidence: the wiki's 'Items required' annotation is the
discriminator, per the wave-12 lesson that being LISTED is not enough.

reviewed.20e0b80487 phoenix feather: The Golem: a genuine fetch, not granted (owner review, wave 12 — overturned in this direction along with barronite deposit).
reviewed.ade050c74d barronite deposit: Defender of Varrock: a genuine fetch, not granted (owner review, wave 12).
reviewed.95213feaa2 silverlight key: Demon Slayer: explicit owner correction (wave 9). The finishing step needs 3 keys; the bones/coin/bucket spent on the earlier key legs were pruned instead.
reviewed.0da34b3a89 ring of charos(a): While Guthix Sleeps: wiki Items required lists 'Ring of Charos(a) or 500 coins' as a BRING item, not under 'Obtainable during quest'.
reviewed.326668c883 hangover cure: Plague City: wiki lists 'Hangover cure or the ingredients to make one' as a bring item, and the guide makes it two steps earlier (fa497e8b66). Bring-then-consume-in-finale is a GOOD kit entry per wave 9.
